meta.title: Bids cannot be unlocked before the submission window closes
gaps: Directly verify the backend unlock operation was not performed or inspect bid visibility beyond the UI's hidden-bids message.
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Directly verify the backend unlock operation was not performed or inspect bid visibility beyond the UI's hidden-bids message.

steps.note: Open a suitable existing live event whose submission window is still open.
Navigate to the Responses tab specified by the case.
Verify the Settings menu offers Unlock Bids only as disabled before the deadline.

args.text: Bids of participated vendors will be visible once the event duration is over.

steps.note: Confirm the Responses view still indicates that bids remain hidden until the event ends.
